title: Curated list, sites on the latitude-longitude product: past landings, 24 months
description: Site records of the data stream (data/sites/curated_sites.json): past landing sites at the lander positions measured on LROC images. Real terrain from every approved elevation product, without the 5 m near field; SPICE ephemeris. The requirements are the team's examples, not requirements of NASA or of any mission. No uncertainty is stated for these sites: no terrain height error has been measured for the product that serves them.
